case_number: 2023 INSC 703; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 2363 OF 2023 arising out of SLP (Crl.) No. 9710/2023
summary: Conviction under Abkari Act Section 8; admissibility of official witnesses as sole evidence; delay in filing challan (3 years) not fatal; interpolation in Mahazar (375ml to 180ml) disregarded; bias claim against investigator rejected; precedent reliance on Mukesh Singh; no requirement for independent witnesses per Tahir and Karamjiti Singh; conviction upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985
Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.7, s.13(2), s.13(1)(d)
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction and sentence (1 year RI + Rs. 1 lakh fine) confirmed.
